title: Passes manifest
description: One row per raw proposer/verifier execution (run_N). Passes belong to the RUN, not the condition — N-sweeps share a pass pool (consensus-n5 and consensus-n10 are the same passes aggregated differently), so a pass cannot be owned by a single condition. The pass OWNS the generation config and the cost/token/timing facts.

pass_id.description: Primary key. Convention: {run_id}::{proposer_pool}::run{N}. The condition does NOT appear in the key (passes belong to the run).

run_id.description: Foreign key to the runs manifest.

proposer_pool.description: Which generation config produced this pass. Conditions consume the first N passes of a pool.

model_used.description: AUTHORITATIVE model identity, read from per_item_metadata.model_used. NEVER inferred from the directory/condition name — a 'pro-'named condition was verified to have run Flash (memory 2026-05-28-b6bc50ca773e). Empty string allowed only for failed/empty items.

model_requested.description: Model asked for, from per_item_metadata.model_requested (may differ from model_used).

instruction_hash.description: Hash of the system instruction — captures prompt version AND detects silent drift (better than a version string).

library_hash.description: Hash of the few-shot example library.

n_tiles_processed.description: TILES completed. Proposer passes only. NULL for verifier passes (E72, 2026-08-02): a verifier operates on candidate crops and its meta records candidate ids, never tile ids, so no tile count exists to report — the crop count lives in n_candidates_verified and n_tiles_null_reason says why this is null. Before E72 this column carried the crop count for verifier rows (E71 Defect 2 / GAP-8), which made the column non-comparable across rows; before E71 it carried tiles-dispatched where per_item_metadata existed. Required but nullable: a row must state a tile count or state that none exists.

n_tiles_null_reason.description: Why n_tiles_processed is null. Populated for verifier passes (E72); null whenever n_tiles_processed carries a count. Never a substitute for a derivable count — if genuine tile data appears in a future meta era, the count is recorded and this returns to null.

n_candidates_verified.description: Candidate crops COMPLETED by a verifier pass (E72). Null for proposer passes, which have no candidate stage. This is where the crop-scale count that E71 Defect 2 mislabelled as tiles now lives, under a name that says what it counts.

n_tiles_dispatched.description: TILES dispatched per per_item_metadata, where available (E71). Null for meta eras without per-item records, and null for verifier passes (E72 — per_item_metadata there records candidate-crop API items, not tiles). dispatched minus processed = tiles that produced no output.

timestamps.description: Pass start/end (UTC). These feed the run's derived (not stored) dates_run.

pass.$comment: Lenient back-fill policy: identity (pass_id, run_id, proposer_pool, pass_n), the authoritative model_used, modality, status, n_tiles_processed, and provenance are required. n_tiles_processed stays REQUIRED but is nullable (E72): the contract is that a row must account for its tile coverage — with a count, or with an explicit null plus n_tiles_null_reason. Cost/token/timing fields are nullable so older runs without a cost_manifest.json still validate.
